# Roushan Kumar - Product Designer

> Official portfolio of Roushan Kumar, a product designer based in Ahmedabad, India. Roushani is his mobile invoicing product for service businesses. His work includes B2B SaaS, fintech, enterprise workflows, mobile products, and design systems.

Roushan works from research and information architecture through interface design and handoff to engineering.

## Direct answers

- **Who is Roushan Kumar?** A UX/UI and product designer based in Ahmedabad, India.
- **What does he work on?** B2B and SaaS workflows, enterprise products, fintech, mobile experiences, and design systems.
- **What is Roushani?** A mobile-first invoicing product designed for service businesses.
- **How can you contact him?** Email roushan.ux@gmail.com or use the LinkedIn profile below.

## Primary sources

- [Full text portfolio and profile](https://roushan.in/portfolio.md): authoritative profile, contact details, and selected project descriptions.
- [Portfolio home page](https://roushan.in/): visual portfolio and project overview.
- [About Roushan](https://roushan.in/about)

## Selected projects

- [Roushani - mobile-first B2B invoicing SaaS](https://roushan.in/case-studies/roushani): Production MVP delivered in four weeks; product strategy, research, invoicing flows, customer and service reuse, branding, and PDF export.
- [Umbrella - enterprise third-party onboarding](https://roushan.in/case-studies/umbrella): NDA onboarding redesign informed by five usability sessions; clearer structure, validation, visual hierarchy, and user flow.
- [Design system, components, and icons](https://roushan.in/case-studies/design-system-icons): A dedicated project page for reusable components and icon work.
- [Bridge2Business B2B website redesign](https://roushan.in/case-studies/bridge2business): Responsive website UX, service messaging, information hierarchy, and brand credibility.
- [Maxlence HR and project management SaaS](https://roushan.in/case-studies/maxlence): Connected HR, attendance, project tracking, and client delivery workflows.
- [Naie salon discovery and booking](https://roushan.in/case-studies/naie): Mobile salon discovery, booking availability, and salon-owner operations.
